import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length1_17/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length1_17/training_1.csv"

df_schools = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df_students = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Join on 'school_name' to combine school info with student info
df_merged = pd.merge(df_schools, df_students, on="school_name", how="inner")

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
target_columns = [
    'School ID', 'school_name', 'type', 'size', 'budget',
    'Student ID', 'student_name', 'gender', 'grade', 'reading_score', 'math_score'
]
df_target = df_merged[target_columns]

# Ensure data types match target schema
df_target = df_target.astype({
    'School ID': 'int64',
    'school_name': 'string',
    'type': 'string',
    'size': 'int64',
    'budget': 'int64',
    'Student ID': 'int64',
    'student_name': 'string',
    'gender': 'string',
    'grade': 'string',
    'reading_score': 'int64',
    'math_score': 'int64'
})

# Write the final target table to the specified path without the index
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_17/target_multisource.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
